name: oppia-research-compass
description: 10 complete Oppia research methods and full read-only 10-tool runtime. Private team evidence DB and project handles excluded; schema-compatible zero-row corpus supplied.

interface.shortDescription: Oppia evidence first, focused research skills second.
interface.longDescription: Find and reuse historical Oppia UX evidence, assess its limits, and design focused follow-up research for an authorized Oppia team decision. Includes evidence retrieval, question framing, interviews, usability tests, comparisons, personas, expert evaluations and user journeys. The bundled corpus is internal historical evidence, not live Drive or web access. Public source edition contains no real research corpus or private project handles. Receiving teams supply their own authorized evidence; installation adds no automatic provider.
defaultPrompt: What has past Oppia research found about onboarding?
